notes.title: New Hustle Cat Build!
notes.content:
Good morning fellow Hustlers!

We just kicked build 58 live, which should improve both game stability and catch even more cases of save file corruption.

As a note: if your game crashes after the interview, please uninstall and reinstall Steam! This is an error in unlocking an achievement, and appears to be related to an error in the Steam client itself.

As always, if you're having trouble please email us at support@datenighto.com and we'll work with you to fix your issue.

Thanks again!

notes.title: A Quick Game Update
notes.content:
Good evening, fellow cat hustlers! 

We've issued a new build (46) this evening that will address problems with save file corruption in the rare case that your computer crashes during play. If you're one of the few users experiencing black screens on startup after a computer crash, this should resolve your issue.

Thanks again, and we hope you're enjoying the game!
